phase_name: Rewrite the CI workflow to deploy-then-verify

objectives.description: Rewrite workflow: rename workflow/job to reflect full gate suite
Steps: checkout -> install neovim -> deploy with hatch -> verify-deploy.sh
Run aggregator without --skip-slow, document as deliberate
Treat exit 2 as failure, confirm no step swallows non-zero exit
Comment which gate scripts deliberately not run and why
Keep existing triggers (push to master, pull_request)

verification.yaml_parses: python3 yaml.safe_load succeeds; 'on' key normalizes to boolean True per YAML 1.1 (expected/harmless -- GitHub's own parser is YAML-1.1-aware and handles this correctly; the original file already used the same unquoted 'on:' convention)
verification.no_swallowed_exit: grep for '|| true' and 'continue-on-error' across the file matches only the explanatory prose comment, not any actual step
verification.deliberate_exclusions_named: check-deploy-freshness.sh and check-consumer-freshness.sh both named with rationale in header comment
verification.triggers_unchanged: push:[master] and pull_request kept from original file
verification.note: deploy-headless.sh's own inline verify (fast gates, --skip-slow) can already fail the 'Deploy .claude/ from the source store' step before the full-suite step runs -- this is correct: no need to run the slow full suite if fast gates are already red
